Label.summary: Static text label that measures its text and resizes itself when autosize is enabled

props.defaultWidth: Default width in pixels, 70, used when width is not set explicitly
props.defaultHeight: Default height in pixels, 20, used when height is not set explicitly
props.padding: Inner padding {left, top, right, bottom} in pixels, default {0,0,0,0}
props.autosize: Resize the control to fit its text, default true; when false the caption is wrapped to the control width/height instead
props.autoObeyLineHeight: When autosizing, derive the height from lineHeight (same line count gives the same height); requires autosize, default true
props.align: Horizontal alignment 'left'/'center'/'right', default "left"; also positions the label itself when autosizing
props.caption: Text to display, default "no text"; only SetCaption triggers a re-layout and repaint
props.noFont: Skip automatic creation of the default font object, default false

Label:New.desc: Construct a Label: call the inherited New, then SetCaption to initialize the caption and run the first layout/repaint

params.obj: Property table that overrides the defaults

Label:SetCaption.desc: Set the text; returns immediately when unchanged, otherwise updates caption and triggers UpdateLayout and Invalidate

Label:UpdateLayout.desc: Re-layout: when autosizing, measure the text and call _UpdateConstraints to position itself; otherwise generate the wrapped text

Label:DrawControl.desc: Draw _caption inside the control rectangle via font:DrawInBox with align/valign; draws a green debug border when debug is true

fileDesc: Defines the Label class: an auto-sizing static text label that measures, wraps and draws its text.
